jobs_results.title: Fullstack Developer - Python, React, JavaScript
jobs_results.description:
About Bottomless

We make a smart subscription that ships based on usage instead of a fixed schedule.

Customers just store their product on a smart scale (which lasts for over a year on a single battery charge) and never have to worry about their product supply again.

Our subscription also includes a queue builder and other advanced features.

YCombinator W19.

About The Role

We are a fast growing startup with a product used by thousands of consumers every day. We are looking for a jack-of-all-trades full stack developer. The ideal candidate for this position would be able to dive into any kind of project, from frontend UI/UX tasks in React.js to backend tasks running on Node.js. If you’re interested in variety and working hard to build something big, this might be a good fit. We need to achieve 80% of the results with 20% of the effort.

What You’ll Bring

Expert proficiency required:
• Node.js
• NoSQL databases
• React.js
• English (written and verbal) Intermediate proficiency... at a minimum:
• UI/UX design
• Software architecture Basic proficiency, at a minimum:
• Python (background tasks) Not required, but a plus:
• Embedded systems (C++)
• Machine learning (scipy, numpy, pandas)
• Data science (time series modeling, collaborative filtering

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack, 3+ years experience)
jobs_results.description:
At WE ARE CRISP, we transform ecommerce stores from ordinary to extraordinary. Specializing in Shopify ecommerce solutions, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional results for businesses looking to elevate their online presence.

Now, we’re searching for a passionate and experienced Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack) to join our dynamic team.

As a Full Stack Developer at WE ARE CRISP, you will play a crucial role in creating highly functional Shopify apps.

Working alongside a team of talented professionals, you'll have the opportunity to bring your technical skills to the forefront, directly impacting the success of our clients' projects.

Tasks
• Build exceptional Shopify apps & integrations: You'll design and build React & Node.js based application that integrate with Shopify and other platforms
• Work Together: You'll join forces with our project managers and designers to turn ideas into reality.
• Solve Problems: When things get tricky, you'll figure out how to fix them.
•... Talk Tech: Sometimes, you'll need to explain your tech solutions to our team.
• Keep Learning: Frontend development, ecommerce and Shopify are always changing, and you'll need to keep up.

Requirements
• Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Node.js, React, Typescript. Experience with Redis.
• Full Stack Development experience: Minimum 3 years backend & 2 years frontend.
• Strong backend development focus: A large part of the work will be related to backend development related tasks.
• Shopify Experience: Not required, but a big plus.
• Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify issues and implement practical solutions.
• Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to detail with a focus on creating flawless online experiences.
• Communication Skills: Excellent ability to communicate effectively in English.
• Eagerness to Learn: A constant desire to grow and adapt to new web technologies and challenges.

Benefits
• Flexibility: Enjoy a truly flexible work schedule and complete location independence.
• Professional Growth: Access to personal and professional development courses, industry conferences, and a chance to work on challenging and rewarding projects.
• Supportive Environment: Be part of a friendly, professional team that values quality and open communication.
• Company Culture: Participate in fun company events and team-building activities

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador fullstack (web interfaces)
jobs_results.description:
El Sistema de Observación y Predicción Costero de las Illes Balears (ICTS SOCIB) es un consorcio público estatal conforme a la Ley 40/2015 de 1 de octubre de Régimen Jurídico del Sector Público que persigue como fin fundacional construir equipar y operar en las Illes Balears. La ICTS SOCIB es una Infraestructura Científica y Técnica Singular (ICTS) incluida en el mapa de ICTS desde 2014.

La misión de la ICTS SOCIB es operar un sistema de observación y predicción en el Mediterráneo Occidental y proporcionar datos instalaciones servicios y herramientas digitales para avanzar en la comprensión del océano y transferir conocimiento a la sociedad.

El Centro de Datos de la ICTS SOCIB desarrolla e implementa un sistema general de gestión de datos para garantizar el seguimiento de estándares internacionales la calidad de los datos y la interoperabilidad. La diversidad de tipos de datos de la ICTS SOCIB requiere métodos apropiados para la ingesta catalogación visualización y distribución de... esta información.

En este contexto SOCIB quiere contratar una persona responsable de las aplicaciones web del SOCIB unas aplicaciones cuyos objetivos son que los usuarios puedan localizar visualizar y descargar datos e información de su interés el apoyo a la operación del sistema multiplataforma la difusión de la información institucional y divulgativa del SOCIB el apoyo al sistema de información y métricas del SOCIB la correcta catalogación de la documentación generada por el SOCIB etc.

En términos generales la persona contratada será responsable de las siguientes tareas
• Diseño desarrollo y evolución de las aplicaciones y páginas web del SOCIB con especial énfasis en el desarrollo de visualizaciones de datos meteo-oceanográficos.
• Despliegue en producción de las aplicaciones web siguiendo la estrategia basada en contenedores (e.g. docker) y despliegue automático del SOCIB.
• Monitorización del estado de las páginas web y resolución de incidencias.
• Administración de los servidores web servidores docker junto al servicio de sistemas de información.
• Colaboración con el resto de divisiones en la puesta en marcha de nuevas aplicaciones que permitan el cumplimiento de los objetivos del Plan Estratégico y planes plurianuales del SOCIB.
• Preparación técnica de licitaciones para el desarrollo de aplicaciones web y seguimiento del desarrollo de dichos contratos con empresas externas.
• Generación de software con un código limpio que pueda ser publicado y reutilizado que siga estándares internacionales y que se base en tecnologías libres. Adaptación a nuevas herramientas del ámbito web.
• Programación en python javascript css html bash java php go a partir del conocimiento de los siguientes conceptos control de versiones calidad de código despliegue automático servicios web seguridad formato de datos meteo-oceanográficos acceso a bases de datos tecnologías geoespaciales UX (User eXperience).

Requerimientos para la aplicación y su acreditación

Formación académica
• Grado en Informática Matemáticas Física Telecomunicaciones o en cualquier campo relevante.

Experiencia laboral
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia laboral como desarrollador/a de software.

El proceso de contratación se realizará de acuerdo a lo descrito en las bases específicas de la plaza
• https //www.socib.es/files/P-001 2024 Desarrollador 20Full-stack 20especializado 20en 20interfaces 20de 20usuario.pdf

Y las bases generales
• https //www.socib.es/files/Bases 20generales 10plazas2024 v2.pdf

Django, Vue, Nuxt, Bootstrap, Leaflet, GIS, Web Map Service, Docker, Linux

jobs_results.title: Java Fullstack Developer
jobs_results.description:
Con la llegada de la primavera, ¿te apetece afrontar un nuevo reto profesional? ¡Esta oportunidad puede ayudarte a conseguir tus objetivos!

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo internacional y buscamos a un/a Java Fullstack Developer con más de 5 años de experiencia.

🤗 ¿QUIÉNES SOMOS?

En Altia creamos soluciones digitales preparadas para el futuro, capaces de generar valor real y provocar cambios significativos.

Nos mueve un claro propósito: crecer haciendo crecer, y hacerlo, además, de forma sostenible y duradera. Tenemos claro que solo seremos importantes si juntos aportamos un impacto positivo y todos evolucionamos en el proceso.

101418-FullStack Developer (Mobile Strategy)

Senior Full-Stack Developer

Mobile Strategy for Agricultural Solutions

Madrid, Spain

APPLY

Our client is a global leader in the chemical industry and is characterized by the development of innovative solutions in various sectors.

Join its rapid-growing and international Digital Hub in Madrid, and contribute to the expansion of its innovative Agricultural Solutions:

Your Responsibilities:
• Responsible for the technical and functional development of both iOS and Android applications for internal and external users
• Conceptualize, design, and implement innovative mobile solutions in the agricultural domain
• Manage a portfolio of multiple live apps in various countries, ensuring seamless performance
• Contribute to comprehensive Solutions Design documentation and collaborate with Architecture and Solutions communities
• Showcase Agriculture Practice's in-house platform for mobility, emphasizing... practical applications and benefits
• Enhance AI-related skills and lead efforts to expand mobile ecosystems, focusing on market intelligence and workflow automations

Your Profile:
• Academic Degree in Computer Science or other related fields
• Experienced developer for Mobile Applications on iOS and/or Android platforms
• Comprehensive skill set covering design, testing, and troubleshooting
• Confident in both backend and frontend development
• Hands-on experience in Microservices, RestAPIs, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines
• Understanding of data-centric approaches and governance
• Innovative team player with analytical thinking and a passion for creating exceptional experiences
• High level of English
• Advantageous: Basics in German and/or Spanish and ETL process knowledge

Your Benefits:
• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
• Multiple employee discounts, company's stock options and various team events
• Remote friendly policy
• Opportunity to lead strategic mobile development projects
• Be a part of an international team with diverse backgrounds, where respect, support and openness are key
• Opportunities for individual training and development

If you are interested in this challenging position we are looking forward to receiving your comprehensive application for ref.no. 101,418 preferably through our ISG career portal or via email.

Visit isg.com/jobs/search - here you can find new job offers every day.
